AAA Ltd also manufactures coil units, air handling units, humidifiers and a wide variety of stylish, contemporary and energy-efficient split type and floor standing room air conditioners for both residential as well as commercial applications. AAA markets these products under the brand name of DAIKOOL in Pakistan. We have offices in major cities of Pakistan. AAA’s integrated business model of a manufacturer, contractor and after – sales service provider enables it to offer an end – to – end solution to its customers which has proved to be a significant differentiator in the market place.
